create_gangs_factory: create a GangsFactory to build parallel gangs from a GangSection config and WorldInfo
create_gangs: create parallel gangs with tensor parallelism by calling the GangsFactory create method
create_fsdp_gangs_factory: create an FSDPGangsFactory to set up FSDP or hybrid sharded data parallel gangs
create_fsdp_gangs: create FSDP gangs from existing Gangs using the FSDPGangsFactory create method with hybrid support
warmup_gangs: warm up gangs by performing a collective barrier call across the root gang
